entities.name: Mitsunobu etherification
observations: The terminal alcohol of the cyclic-carbamate substrate couples with the phenolic oxygen of the sulfur-containing substrate to form an aryl propyl ether.
The sulfur-containing heterocycle and cyclic carbamate are retained; no new sulfur or phosphorus incorporation is indicated.

entities.name: PBu3/ADDP
observations: Tributylphosphine and 1,1'-(azodicarbonyl)dipiperidine (ADDP) are reported for the matching etherification; benzene is reported as solvent in the closest record.

entities.name: Tributylphosphine
observations: Likely Mitsunobu phosphine reagent; not incorporated into the product.

entities.name: ADDP
observations: 1,1'-(Azodicarbonyl)dipiperidine; azo reagent used with tributylphosphine for the etherification.
